mapping_method: 55 sorted scenario IDs per serial repetition; 165 consecutively numbered traces per stage; numeric client generations crosschecked
limits: 358 counts first-phrase TTS-ready occurrences before the one annotated T5 turn ends; it is not 358 executions, all replies, all voice onsets, or all annotated pauses.
343 counts trace-event-order membership after detected vad_start and before its first sustained/end/drop; VAD start is not the annotated acoustic resume boundary.
331 qualifying windows close at sustained, 12 at vad_end, and none at drop. Duration varies with unvoiced frames; sustained counts voiced windows rather than a fixed wall duration.
Artifact start_audio_s uses vad_start.at_s, but close_audio_s uses trace.audio_s (receipt clock). Use event order for membership; mixed fields are not an exact VAD duration.
phrase=0 means first audio ready for the first phrase of an answer turn, including answers later stopped. It does not establish listener audibility.
Client seq0 presence and played=true establish packet acceptance under the synthetic playback rule, not exact audible onset or heard extent.
Trace-to-run association uses serial sorted order and cardinalities; matching generation sets adds a check but no explicit session ID was transmitted.
dbde3fd is the analysis checkout. 0e35605 was the reported capture checkout; imported source was not hashed at engine startup, so loaded engine revisions remain unknown.

annotation_crosscheck.timestamp: server receipt audio_s compared with benchmark input annotations; no listener audibility inference
